messages:
sara_sales: Heads-up — ACME wants to close by EOW but asking for a temporary 25% POC discount tied to a 6mo commit. Need deal-desk guidance.
raj_dealdesk: 25% is above threshold. What's ARR if we convert after POC? Any infra/security blockers?
maria_revops: If they commit 6mo reserved at $X/mo we can do up to 20% w/ legal signoff. For >20% need VP approval. Also need to tag commit in quote as 'POC-temp' so revops can track.
tom_eng: Tech note: they want dedicated capacity for POC (4 GPUs) w/ burst. Runtime ok but need a datacenter region match (eu-west). No blockers from infra.
sara_sales: They will likely convert to full annual if perf hits. Can we try to offer 20% plus a one-time onboarding credit instead of 25%?
raj_dealdesk: That I can approve. Replace percent with a $15,000 onboarding credit. Also list the ratecard version they'll be billed on.
ratebot: Ratecard v2.4.0 published — change log: new commit tiers, legacy branch handling. Link: https://internal.redwood/ratecards/v2.4.0
maria_revops: Important: ratecard v2.4.0 introduces 'branching' semantics. Any POC quoting must include "ratecard_version":"v2.4.0" and optional "legacy_rate_reference":"v2.2.5" if converting pricing later.
sara_sales: example quote line I will use:
```
line_item: Dedicated GPU pool - 4xA100
billing_tier: reserved_6mo
discount: 20%
onboarding_credit: $15,000
ratecard_version: v2.4.0
notes: POC-temp, convert to annual -> apply v2.2.5 grandfathering if requested
```
raj_dealdesk: OK — log this thread in DealDesk tracker and tag @maria_revops. I'll provision the manual approval and sign-off. Include "convert_reason" field in CRM.
maria_revops: I'll add a validation step to ensure we don't auto-apply legacy rates unless legal accepts the clause. Also will generate a short internal FAQ on v2.4.0 branching.
tom_eng: If you need a quick perf SLA for the POC, I can spin a short smoke test and dump perf metrics into the quote.
sara_sales: Thanks all — I'll push the quote with 20% + $15k credit, set ratecard to v2.4.0, and @raj_dealdesk will route approval. Ping me if ops/legal ask for wording. :thumbsup:
